name: Suzuriya Yua
source: The social studies teacher who also doubles as [url=/c83148]Ryou's[/url] homeroom teacher. Her real age is unknown but she calls herself eternally 19. Loves cosplaying and often does it in school. Though she has an easily irritated and selfish personality she's always supportive of her students.
